subject: the estimated item parameters are too large

messages.author: 40fc57d53124bd8d
messages.subject: the estimated item parameters are too large
parts:
I am trying to estimate item parameter for a test with 46 items and 6000+ students. They are estimated using either 2PL or GPCM. I found some of the estimated item parameters are too large. I checked the score distributions of all the items and they look fine to me. i am not sure what went wrong. 

mod_read <- mirt(dat, 1, itemtype=itemTypes)
coef(mod_read)

$item1
        a1      d g u
par 37.609 14.804 0 1

$item2
        a1      d g u
par 37.568 14.826 0 1

$item3 
        a1      d g u
par 37.567 14.811 0 1

$item4
        a1      d g u
par 37.567 14.791 0 1

$item5
      a1     d g u
par 1.13 0.525 0 1

$item6
      a1     d g u
par 1.14 0.536 0 1

.......

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: the estimated item parameters are too large
parts:
If I had to guess here, the first 4 items likely are incredibly easy. I imagine that the positive response rate for a few of these items are greater than 99%, if not higher. In sparse cell situations like these the model may fail to converge by spinning-off into extremely large values. Can you confirm that this may be due to extremely skewed data patterns?  

Phil
